title: Zuva reKuratidzwa Kwekupedzisira
intro: Vashevedzwa kuti varatidze simba guru, boka revanhu vane hunyanzvi vakazviwana vakatarisana nechokwadi chisingatarisirwi chaizochinja hupenyu hwavo nekusingaperi.
clues: Taizivikanwa nehunyanzvi hwedu, nyanzvi dzekufungidzira uye dzekunyengera.
Takadanwa nemutongi kuti tinosangana nemunhu aikwikwidza netsvimbo yake.
Patakaona chokwadi, takawira pasi tichigwadama, tichizivisa kutenda muna Ishe wenyika.
Mudzvinyiriri akatityisidzira nekurangwa kwakaoma, asi hatina kuzununguka.
Taiva pakati pevakatanga kutenda mushoko iri mushure mekunge taona chiratidzo chakajeka.
Takafira kutenda kwedu, asi tichava vekutanga kupinda muParadhiso nevakarurama.
arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
